bv_texto_manej: JavaStreak is the wild boar management support platform. Organize your bait sites and feeder control, record hunting routes by GPS, manage your kennel with each dog's health, log traps and takes, build your trophy room and join the ranking. All in one place, with a map showing the network of handlers and partner companies near you.
bv_texto_emp: JavaStreak connects your company to the wild boar handlers in your region. Register your store to appear on the platform map, publish time-limited promotions, build a showcase of your products and services, and sponsor highlights to widen your reach. You track how many people visit your profile and talk directly with those looking for what you offer.
